items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: I played with the Arnold Band too. Oh. Brass Band. Yeah, Man Forrest, my dad, Ernest Rappanian.

ctx.x: When you followed him, what band was he playing with?

Oh, the Arnold Band. I played with the Arnold Band too. Oh. Brass Band. Yeah, Man Forrest, my dad, Ernest Rappanian. Yeah. I was playing snap drum, and Ernest Rappanian was playing bass drum. How was he, Ernest Rappanian? Oh, he's fine. Fine drummers. Yes, yeah.
Could you give me an idea of what his beat would be like? Would he have a lot of double rap stuff, or would he play it?
